title: Charged at full price after a voucher was applied
context: Order R-482013. A 20 percent voucher was accepted at checkout but the captured amount is the full 96.00. The order record shows the voucher recorded and not deducted. The agent can refund the 19.20 difference to the original card and cannot reissue an expired voucher.
customer_turns: Order R-482013 was charged at ninety-six pounds even though the twenty percent voucher went through at checkout. The confirmation screen showed the reduced total before I paid.
I still have the confirmation email listing the voucher code, but the amount at the bottom is the full price. Your own email contradicts itself.
I want the nineteen twenty difference back on my card. Can you do that today, and how long before it shows on my statement?
resolution_space: Refund the price difference to the original card
Issue store credit for the difference
Decline and explain a voucher exclusion on the items ordered
Escalate to the payments team

title: Delivery charge on an order above the free threshold
context: Order R-490771, basket value 58.00 against a free delivery threshold of 50.00. A 4.95 delivery charge was applied because one item ships from a partner warehouse. The exclusion is stated on the product page. The agent can refund the charge as goodwill once per customer.
customer_turns: I was charged four ninety-five delivery on order R-490771 even though the basket came to fifty-eight pounds. Your banner says delivery is free over fifty.
I have ordered from you several times and never paid delivery on a basket this size. Nothing at checkout warned me that this order would be treated differently.
Refund the four ninety-five or tell me clearly why it stands. If there is an exception I should have seen, show me where it was.
resolution_space: Refund the delivery charge as a one-off goodwill gesture
Explain the partner-warehouse exclusion and uphold the charge
Issue a free-delivery code for a future order
Escalate to the customer care team

title: Pending authorisation held after a cancelled order
context: Order R-501228 was cancelled by the warehouse before dispatch. The 214.00 authorisation is still held on the customer's card. Authorisations release in five to ten days depending on the issuing bank; the agent cannot release them directly.
customer_turns: You cancelled order R-501228 yourselves because the item was out of stock, but two hundred and fourteen pounds is still showing as pending on my card six days later.
Your email said no payment had been taken. My bank shows the money as unavailable to me, so whatever it is called, I cannot spend it.
Tell me exactly when that hold disappears and what you can do to speed it up. I need the money before the weekend.
resolution_space: Issue a written release confirmation the customer can give their bank
Explain the authorisation window and the bank's role
Request an expedited void through the payment provider
Escalate to the payments team

title: Billed for an item that was never in the parcel
context: Order R-512900 of four items, invoiced at 143.00. The parcel weight recorded at dispatch is consistent with three items. The agent can refund the missing item at 31.00 or resend it, and can open a warehouse investigation.
customer_turns: Order R-512900 was billed for four items but only three arrived. The invoice in the box lists all four, and the packaging was sealed and undamaged when it reached me.
The missing one is the thirty-one pound lamp, which is the largest of the four. There is clearly not room in that box for it, so it was never packed.
I would rather have the lamp than the money, but I need to know today which you are giving me and when it arrives.
resolution_space: Resend the missing item with a stated delivery date
Refund the missing item to the original payment method
Open a warehouse investigation before deciding
Escalate to the fulfilment team

title: Price dropped the day after purchase
context: Order R-523114, placed on the 3rd at 180.00; the same item listed at 144.00 on the 4th. The published price-promise window is fourteen days and covers price reductions on the retailer's own site. The agent can refund the 36.00 difference.
customer_turns: I bought a coat on order R-523114 for a hundred and eighty pounds, and the next day your site had it at a hundred and forty-four.
I looked for your price promise and the page mentions matching other retailers, but it is not obvious whether your own reductions count for something already ordered.
Can you refund the thirty-six pound difference, or do I have to return it and buy it again? Tell me which is quicker.
resolution_space: Refund the price difference under the price promise
Cancel and reorder at the lower price
Decline and explain the promise terms
Escalate to the customer care team

title: Subscription box charged after a skip request
context: Subscription S-77401. The customer requested a skip for October through the app; the log shows the request submitted eleven hours after the cut-off. The 39.00 box has shipped. The agent can refund on return, can waive return postage, and cannot recall a shipped box.
customer_turns: I asked to skip October on subscription S-77401 and you charged and shipped it anyway. Thirty-nine pounds went out on the same day I made the request in the app.
The app did not warn me that I had missed a cut-off. It accepted the skip and showed October as skipped on the schedule screen afterwards.
I do not want the box. Tell me whether I get the thirty-nine pounds back and whether I am paying to send it to you.
resolution_space: Refund on return with prepaid return postage
Refund without requiring the box to be returned
Uphold the charge and skip the following month instead
Escalate to the subscriptions team

title: Parcel marked delivered but not received
context: Order R-530918. The courier records delivery to a safe place on the 9th with a photograph of a doorway that is not the customer's. The agent can issue a replacement immediately or refund, and must record a non-delivery claim with the courier.
customer_turns: Order R-530918 says delivered on the ninth but nothing arrived. The photograph on the tracking page shows a blue front door and mine is white with a glass panel.
I have asked both neighbours and checked with the building's post room. Nobody has it, and no card was left anywhere on the property.
Please either send it again or refund me. I need it by Friday, so if a replacement cannot arrive by then, refund instead.
resolution_space: Dispatch a replacement with a stated delivery date
Refund the order in full
Open a courier non-delivery claim before deciding
Escalate to the delivery investigations team

title: Order stuck at preparing for dispatch
context: Order R-541220, placed nine days ago, status preparing for dispatch. Stock shows zero for one of the three items. The agent can split the order and ship the available items today, can cancel the unavailable item, and cannot give a restock date.
customer_turns: My order R-541220 has said preparing for dispatch for nine days. Nothing has moved on the tracking page and I have had no emails since the confirmation.
There are three items in it and two of them are for a birthday on Saturday. The third is not urgent and I would happily wait for that one separately.
Can you send what you have now and deal with the rest later? If not, tell me and I will cancel the whole thing.
resolution_space: Split the order and ship available items today
Cancel the unavailable item and refund it
Hold the order until complete with a revised estimate
Escalate to the fulfilment team

title: Refund not received after a returned parcel
context: Return RET-22890, received back at the warehouse fifteen days ago. The published refund window is ten working days from receipt. The refund of 74.50 is queued but not processed. The agent can expedite it to two working days.
customer_turns: I returned a parcel under RET-22890 and your warehouse scanned it in fifteen days ago. The seventy-four fifty has not come back.
Your policy says ten working days from receipt, which has now passed. The tracking clearly shows it was signed for, so there is no question about whether you have it.
Give me a date for the refund. If you cannot give me one, say so and I will take it up with my card provider instead.
resolution_space: Expedite the refund with a stated settlement date
Refund as store credit immediately
Reinspect the return before releasing the refund
Escalate to the returns team

title: Click-and-collect order not ready at the store
context: Order R-552017 for collection at the Riverside store, marked ready to collect. Store stock shows the item allocated but not located. The agent can reallocate to another store six miles away for same-day collection or convert to home delivery for the next day.
customer_turns: I drove to the Riverside store for click-and-collect order R-552017 after your ready-to-collect email. The desk spent twenty minutes looking and could not find it anywhere.
They told me to contact you rather than waiting. I do not have a car tomorrow, so going back to that store is not something I can easily do.
What are my options that do not involve me returning to Riverside? Give me them with times and costs, and I will choose now.
resolution_space: Reallocate to the nearby store for same-day collection
Convert to next-day home delivery at no charge
Refund the order in full
Escalate to the store operations team

title: Furniture delivery window missed twice
context: Order R-560442, a sofa with a two-man delivery. Two booked windows passed with no delivery and no contact. The next available slot is eighteen days out. The agent can offer a 50.00 goodwill credit and can request a priority slot with no guarantee.
customer_turns: My sofa on order R-560442 has had two delivery windows and neither happened. Both times I waited the whole day and nobody arrived or called to explain.
I have no seating in the living room because I disposed of the old sofa before the first date. That is now nearly three weeks of an empty room.
I need a date that will actually hold, and I want to know what you are doing about the two that did not.
resolution_space: Book a priority slot and confirm the earliest realistic date
Apply a goodwill credit for the failed deliveries
Cancel the order and refund in full
Escalate to the large-item delivery team

title: Pre-order release date passed with no update
context: Pre-order R-571339 for an item whose release date passed eight days ago. The supplier has moved the release by three weeks and no customer notification was sent. The agent can cancel with a full refund, can hold the pre-order, and cannot advance the supplier date.
customer_turns: I pre-ordered an item on R-571339 for release on the second. That date passed over a week ago and I have heard absolutely nothing from you since.
The money was taken at the time of the pre-order, so you have had a hundred and twenty pounds of mine for two months with nothing to show for it.
Tell me the real release date and whether I can cancel and get the money back now. I want both answers before I decide.
resolution_space: Cancel the pre-order and refund in full
Hold the pre-order and confirm the revised release date
Offer a goodwill credit for the delay and keep the order
Escalate to the buying team

title: Checkout fails at the payment step
context: Customer account A-88102. Checkout fails with a generic error at the payment step on card and wallet. Logs show the failures come from an address-verification mismatch with the saved billing address. The agent can clear the saved address and can place the order manually.
customer_turns: Your checkout fails every time I try to pay on account A-88102. It thinks for a moment and then shows an error that just says something went wrong.
I have tried two different cards and a digital wallet, on both my laptop and my phone. My bank confirms no attempt has even reached them, so it is failing before that.
Can you place the order for me, or fix whatever is wrong on the account? The sale ends tonight, so timing matters here.
resolution_space: Clear the saved billing address and have the customer retry
Place the order manually on the customer's behalf
Extend the sale price for this customer beyond the deadline
Escalate to the web platform team

title: Appliance failed within the warranty period
context: Order R-580226, a kettle delivered four months ago with a two-year warranty. The fault described matches a known batch defect under a manufacturer advisory. The agent can arrange a direct replacement without inspection under that advisory.
customer_turns: The kettle from order R-580226 has stopped heating. It was delivered four months ago and it powers on, lights up, and then simply never boils the water.
I have tried it on two different sockets and descaled it as the manual says. Nothing changed, and there is a faint burning smell when it runs now.
I would like a replacement rather than a repair. Can you do that, and do I need to send the old one back first?
resolution_space: Send a direct replacement under the manufacturer advisory
Arrange collection and inspection before replacing
Refund the item in full
Escalate to the product safety team

title: Loyalty points not credited for recent orders
context: Account A-90337. Three orders in the last two months show no loyalty points. The account was migrated to a new loyalty scheme in August and points accrual was not re-linked. The agent can credit missing points manually after checking order values.
customer_turns: My loyalty points have not moved on account A-90337 despite three orders in the last two months. The balance is exactly what it was at the end of July.
I did get an email in August about the scheme changing, and I clicked through and accepted the new terms at the time. Everything else on my account looks normal.
Please add the points I should have earned and confirm the new balance. I want to use them on an order this week.
resolution_space: Credit the missing points manually and confirm the balance
Re-link the account to the loyalty scheme and backdate accrual
Offer an equivalent voucher instead of points
Escalate to the loyalty team

title: Wrong size shipped against the size guide
context: Order R-591804 for a jacket in size medium. The delivered garment is labelled medium but measures to the size guide's small. A supplier sizing error is recorded for this batch. The agent can exchange for a large at the medium price and can refund with free return.
customer_turns: The jacket on order R-591804 is labelled medium but it fits like a small. I measured it against your own size guide and the chest is four centimetres under.
I usually take a medium in your clothing and have three other items from you that fit properly. So this is not me having ordered the wrong size.
I want one that actually fits. Is a large going to be right given the mislabelling, and will I pay the difference?
resolution_space: Exchange for a large at the original price with free return
Refund in full with free return postage
Send a replacement medium from a different batch
Escalate to the buying and quality team

title: Digital gift card code not working
context: Gift card GC-44821 for 50.00, purchased eleven days ago. The code is valid but was partially redeemed for 12.00 against an order the recipient does not recognise. The agent can void the balance and reissue a new code for the remaining 38.00 and can investigate the redemption.
customer_turns: The gift card code GC-44821 my sister sent me will not work at checkout. It was for fifty pounds and your site says the balance is not enough for my order.
My order is only forty-five pounds, so fifty should easily cover it. I have never used this code before and it arrived by email eleven days ago.
Can you tell me what happened to the missing money and give me a working code for what is left? I would like both today.
resolution_space: Void the card and reissue the remaining balance as a new code
Investigate the earlier redemption before reissuing
Reissue the full original value as a goodwill decision
Escalate to the gift card fraud team

title: Order confirmation emails not arriving
context: Account A-91550. Confirmation and dispatch emails are not delivered; the mail log shows hard bounces from the customer's domain. The registered address contains a typographic error. The agent can correct the address and resend the last three confirmations.
customer_turns: I do not receive any emails from you on account A-91550. No order confirmations, no dispatch notices, nothing, although the orders themselves go through fine.
I have checked the spam folder every time and added your address to my contacts. My other online accounts email me at the same address without any trouble.
Please find out why and resend my recent confirmations. I need the last one for an expenses claim that is due on Monday.
resolution_space: Correct the registered email address and resend recent confirmations
Send the confirmations to an alternative address supplied on the call
Provide the order details in writing by post
Escalate to the digital support team

title: Cancelling an order that has already been picked
context: Order R-600471, placed two hours ago, already picked and awaiting courier collection. Cancellation is not possible once picked. The agent can flag for a refuse-on-delivery return or issue a prepaid return label, both refunding in full on receipt.
customer_turns: I placed order R-600471 two hours ago and I need to cancel it. I ordered the wrong model and the right one is a different product entirely.
Your cancel button has already disappeared from the order page, and the status says it is being prepared. Nothing has actually left your building yet as far as I can tell.
So can it be stopped, and if not, what do I do when it arrives? I want the refund without paying postage.
resolution_space: Flag the parcel for refuse on delivery with a full refund
Issue a prepaid return label for return after delivery
Attempt a courier recall before dispatch
Escalate to the fulfilment team

title: Returning a sale item outside the standard window
context: Order R-611228, sale item delivered thirty-six days ago. The standard return window is thirty days, extended to sixty for account holders, which this customer is. The item is unused with tags attached. The agent can accept the return under the extended window.
customer_turns: I would like to return a dress from order R-611228. It was delivered thirty-six days ago and it has never been worn, with the tags still attached.
I know your headline policy says thirty days, and I have gone past that. It was bought for an event that was cancelled, which is why it sat unopened.
Is there any route for me to return it? If there is, tell me what I get back and whether it is money or credit.
resolution_space: Accept the return under the extended account-holder window for a full refund
Accept the return as store credit only
Decline as outside the applicable window
Escalate to the returns team

title: Refund issued to a closed bank card
context: Order R-620993 refunded 129.00 to the original card, which the customer has since cancelled after fraud. Card refunds to closed cards normally route back through the issuer. The agent can reissue by bank transfer after verification if the issuer rejects it.
customer_turns: You refunded a hundred and twenty-nine pounds for order R-620993 to a card I cancelled last month after it was cloned. The bank says nothing has reached my account.
The card number no longer exists, so I do not see how the money can land anywhere. My new card is with the same bank but has a completely different number.
Can you send it to my bank account instead? Tell me what you need to verify me and how long the transfer takes.
resolution_space: Reissue the refund by bank transfer after identity verification
Wait for the issuer to reject and re-route the refund automatically
Issue store credit for the amount instead
Escalate to the finance team

title: Partial refund after a damaged-item return
context: Return RET-24001 for a mirror that arrived cracked. The refund issued was 61.00 against a paid price of 79.00, with an unexplained deduction. Damaged-on-arrival returns are refunded in full including delivery. The agent can release the 18.00 difference.
customer_turns: I returned a cracked mirror under RET-24001 and received sixty-one pounds back. I paid seventy-nine, including delivery, and the crack was there when I opened the box.
There is no explanation anywhere for the eighteen pounds that is missing. Your email just states the refunded amount without breaking it down at all.
I want the rest of my money. Confirm the eighteen pounds is coming and when, or tell me what it was deducted for.
resolution_space: Release the outstanding 18.00 to the original payment method
Provide a breakdown and uphold the deduction
Refund the difference as store credit
Escalate to the returns team

title: Cancelling a recurring subscription box
context: Subscription S-78902, monthly at 39.00, inside a six-month commitment with two months elapsed. Early cancellation carries a 30.00 charge. The agent can pause for up to three months free of charge or cancel with the charge applied.
customer_turns: I want to cancel the monthly box on subscription S-78902. My circumstances have changed and thirty-nine pounds a month is not something I can keep doing.
I signed up in a promotion and I now see there was a six-month commitment attached. I am two months into it, so four are apparently left.
What does stopping it cost me, and is there anything cheaper than cancelling outright? Give me the numbers and I will decide.
resolution_space: Cancel now and apply the early cancellation charge
Pause the subscription for up to three months at no charge
Downgrade to a cheaper tier for the remaining term
Escalate to the subscriptions team

title: Refund for a gift bought by someone else
context: Order R-630558 placed by a third party and shipped to the customer as a gift. The customer has no account and no order confirmation, only a gift receipt. Policy refunds gifts as store credit to the recipient; money refunds go to the purchaser only.
customer_turns: I was given a coffee grinder from order R-630558 as a birthday present. I already own the same model, so I would like to return it unopened.
I do not have an account with you and I did not pay for it. All I have is the gift receipt with the order number.
Would I get money or a credit, and can this be done without involving the person who bought it? I would rather not mention it to them.
resolution_space: Accept the return and issue store credit to the recipient
Refund the purchaser's original payment method only
Offer an exchange for another item of equal value
Escalate to the returns team

title: Two accounts created against one email
context: Email address matches accounts A-92001 and A-92044; orders and loyalty points are split across both. The agent can merge accounts, which moves order history and points to the retained account and cannot be reversed.
customer_turns: It looks like I have two accounts with you under the same email. Some of my orders show in one and some in the other, depending on how I sign in.
My loyalty points are split across both, so neither balance is enough to redeem anything. I have never deliberately created a second account at all.
Can you put them together into one account? Tell me if anything is lost by doing that before you go ahead with it.
resolution_space: Merge the accounts and confirm the combined history and points
Transfer points only, leaving order history separate
Close one account and refund any stored credit
Escalate to the account administration team

title: Unrecognised order on the account
context: Account A-92310 shows order R-641002 for 310.00 shipped to an address the customer does not recognise. Sign-in logs show access from an unfamiliar device. The agent can cancel or recall the order, lock the account, and open a fraud case.
customer_turns: There is an order on my account A-92310 for three hundred and ten pounds going to an address in a city I have never been to. I did not place it.
My saved card was used, and I have just noticed the delivery address list has a new entry added last night that is not mine.
Stop that order if you still can, and secure the account. Tell me what you have done and what I need to do at my end.
resolution_space: Cancel or recall the order and lock the account
Open a fraud case and remove the unrecognised address
Refund the amount pending the fraud investigation
Escalate to the fraud team

title: Cannot update the delivery address on the account
context: Account A-92788. Address updates fail validation because the new address is a new-build not yet in the postal database. The agent can enter a manual address override and can ship to the address once overridden.
customer_turns: I cannot change the delivery address on account A-92788. Your form rejects my new address and says it cannot be found whichever way I type it.
It is a new-build flat that was finished in June. Two other retailers have delivered here fine, but their forms let me type the address without a lookup.
Can you put it on the account manually? I have an order I want to place tonight and it must go to the new address.
resolution_space: Enter a manual address override on the account
Place the order with a one-off manual delivery address
Ship to a nearby collection point instead
Escalate to the digital support team

title: Business account applied to the wrong orders
context: Business account B-11204 with net pricing. Four recent orders were placed under the customer's personal account at retail prices, costing 96.00 more in total. Policy allows retrospective repricing within thirty days; the orders are eighteen days old.
customer_turns: Four recent orders went through on my personal login instead of the business account B-11204. That means I paid retail rather than our agreed net prices.
The difference across the four is about ninety-six pounds, and our finance team will not accept invoices that do not show the business pricing and our reference.
Can you reprice them and reissue the invoices under the business account? I need them before our month end on the thirtieth.
resolution_space: Reprice the orders and reissue business invoices
Refund the price difference without reissuing invoices
Decline repricing and explain the account rules
Escalate to the business accounts team

title: Marketing preferences ignored after opting out
context: Account A-93012. The customer opted out of marketing email six weeks ago; the preference is recorded, but a legacy list in a separate system is still sending. The agent can suppress the address across all systems within 72 hours.
customer_turns: I turned off marketing emails on account A-93012 six weeks ago and I still get several a week from you. The setting in my account shows everything switched off.
I have also used the unsubscribe link at the bottom of two of them. Neither made any difference and one of them returned an error page when I clicked it.
Please stop them properly and tell me when they will actually end. If they continue past that date I want to know who to contact.
resolution_space: Apply a full suppression across all systems with a stated effective date
Confirm the account preference and re-run the unsubscribe
Close the account entirely at the customer's request
Escalate to the data protection team

title: Requesting deletion of a shopping account
context: Account A-93440. The customer asks for account deletion. Two orders are within the returns window and one has an open warranty claim. Policy retains transaction records for six years for tax purposes while deleting profile and marketing data.
customer_turns: I would like my account A-93440 deleted along with everything you hold about me. I do not intend to shop with you again after the last experience.
I do still have an open warranty claim on a blender and one order that has not arrived yet, so I cannot simply walk away this week.
Tell me what can be deleted now, what has to wait, and what you keep regardless. Then I will decide when to go ahead.
resolution_space: Delete profile and marketing data now while retaining transaction records
Schedule deletion for after the open claim and return windows close
Suspend the account instead of deleting it
Escalate to the data protection team
